items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: A fellow by the name of Andre Dominguez used to run that place over there. ... No, no, but I just heard about it.

ctx.x: Yeah, that was, uh, uh, oh, I see. Dominguez. A fellow by the name of Andre Dominguez used to run that place over there. The alley. You went over there? You went there? No, no, but I just heard about it. I'm-

That's right over there. I was a block from here. Yeah, block from here. Biggye Lillie and, and, and, uh, Bechet. Uh-huh. You know, I knew Professor Monetta, when he was teaching me. Yeah, yeah, yeah. He told me about all these different places. Yeah, uh-huh. And then I've been working-
